query: Compare the accuracy, latency, and training cost of ResNet-50, ViT-B/16, and ConvNeXt-T across the retrieved papers, analyze the accuracy trend from 2022 to 2025, and check if parameter count correlates with accuracy.

chunks.text:
Table 1: ImageNet-1K Validation Benchmarks
| Model | Params (M) | Top-1 Accuracy | Latency (ms) |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| ResNet-50 | 25.6 | 76.1% | 12.4 |
| ViT-B/16 | 86.6 | 81.8% | 29.5 |
| ConvNeXt-T | 28.6 | 82.1% | 14.2 |
| Swin-T | 28.3 | 81.3% | 18.7 |

In vision_benchmarks_2025.pdf, all architectures were trained for 300 epochs on ImageNet-1K using the AdamW optimizer and cosine learning-rate decay. Total cloud GPU training cost was $1,200 for ResNet-50, $2,850 for ViT-B/16, and $1,950 for ConvNeXt-T.

Our evaluation in efficient_convnets_2026.pdf reproduces ConvNeXt-T using 7x7 depthwise convolutions and inverted bottleneck blocks, confirming 82.1% Top-1 accuracy and 14.2 ms single-image inference latency on an A100 GPU. Unlike prior studies, GPU training cost was not disclosed in our experimental logs.

Table 2: Annual Best ConvNet Top-1 Accuracy Progression
| Year | Top-1 Accuracy |
| :---: | :---: |
| 2022 | 78.4% |
| 2023 | 80.1% |
| 2024 | 81.5% |
| 2025 | 82.9% |
